context.transcript:
Dr. Lee, I've sent out an email notifying our patients that online scheduling of appointments will be unavailable through Wednesday.
Great.
We should also add a statement to our clinic's homepage, apologizing for the inconvenience as we update our patient portal.
Patients who didn't read your message will see it there.
Okay, I'll go ask Sakura Williams to do that now, since she handles the homepage messaging.
She should still be in her office.

好的。
我们还应该在诊所的首页增加一条声明，为更新我们的患者门户网站给带来的不便表示歉意。
没有阅读您消息的患者会在那里看到它。
好的，我现在去请樱花·威廉姆斯做这件事，因为她负责首页信息发布。
她应该还在她的办公室里。
